Dear Lala

It is nice to meet you. My name is Lilim Yomizuki, and I am a VTuber on YouTube.
I saw your work on Skeb, and the way you drew the characters was so wonderful that I requested you to draw me as well!

I would like to use it in my Vtuber activities (use on monetized channels, announcements, thumbnails, SNS icons and headers, return gifts, neppuri, commercial use as merchandise, etc.).
We will clearly state your name when we use it.

Clothing and composition
We would like you to wear winter or spring clothes, or other casual attire appropriate for the time of delivery.
Hair style, composition, and facial expressions are up to the artist.

Succubus / 120 years old (about the age of an adult in the human world) / born of noble birth / tsundere / lots of PON elements / drinking and gambling / likes cute things, sweets, and roses.

I have rose pink hair color, black mesh bangs, moon highlights in my eyes, a mole under my right eye, double teeth, a tattoo on my left collarbone, and a lewd crest under my belly button! (I try to keep the horns, overhead ring, wings, and tail out of the human world.)

(Horns, rings on the head, wings and tails are not to be shown in the human world.
The color of the image is dark rose pink.

We would appreciate it if you could deliver the image as a psd file with a separate background layer, character layer, and signature.
We would appreciate it if you could also provide us with facial expression differences.

I apologize for pushing so many requests on you.
I know you are busy, but I would appreciate your consideration.

https://photos.app.goo.gl/JehiPFkJspT7mHYB6

Hello! I was very happy with the last request, so I'd like to request another OC, Kalda. She's a viking warrior with a boisterous and confident personality.

Thank you very much!

Hello, Lala! I was very impressed to see the drawings you've done for Skeb already, and wanted to make a request.

Please draw Carmalita.

You could draw her in either of the two outfits in the reference, or give her your own outfit! Anything that could fit or medieval or fantasy setting would be appropriate for her, but I wouldn't mind if you wanted to go more modern either. She's a Cleric from Dungeons & Dragons, though she's also a capable melee fighter (favoring swords).

I leave the details, including mood/pose/expression, entirely up to you.

Thank you for considering my request!
